title: Investigation of the effectiveness of a schematherapy-informed social skills training for individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (Study Part B)
summary:
After reviewing specific criteria, only adults with Autism Spectrum Disorder will take part in the study. Participants will be randomly assigned to one of two groups: an experimental group or a control group.
The psychological assessments will be conducted by experienced and specially trained clinical psychologists. Both groups will participate in eight group sessions, each lasting 100 minutes.
The effectiveness of the intervention will be evaluated at three points in time:
T1: Baseline measurement, one week before the start,
T2: one week after the end, and
T3: one month after the final group session.
Among other things, the study will also assess whether any adverse events have occurred, such as changes in mood, which will be measured using a standardized questionnaire (BDI-II).
To ensure the most objective evaluation possible, independent and trained professionals will conduct the interviews and questionnaires without knowing which group the participants belong to. However, complete blinding (e.g., also for participants) is not possible, as the group assignments are visible.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Fluent in spoken and written German (to ensure understanding of diagnostic assessments and the intervention)
Participant has the capacity to give informed consent
Stable medication for at least 4 weeks
One of the following ICD-10 Diagnoses:
•  F84.0 
•  F84.5 
•  F84.1
•  F84.9
Exclusion criteria:
- Organic mental disorders of the nervous system (ICD-10: F0)
- Acute psychosis or Disorders of consciousness
- Lack of capacity to give informed consent
- Suicidality
